text:
samir: Heads-up  next week is 'Wellness Week' at the SF hub (MonFri). We're rolling out cooling stations, nap-pod reservations, extended meal vouchers, and a short mid-day quiet hour pilot. Quick bullets + links below.

olivia: Love this. Are the meal vouchers for every day?

samir: Short answer: yes for the hub week. Each onsite attendee gets a $12 meal voucher per day (redeemable in the cafe or partner vendors). If you have dietary restrictions, note them on the signup form.

kay: Nap pods? How do we book? Any limits?

facilities: Nap pods: 4 pods available, 30-min slots to start. Book via the calendar: https://cal.redwood/nap-pods. We'll expand if demand is high. Please keep sessions to 30 mins so everyone can use them.

olivia: What's the quiet hour? Is it company-wide?

samir: Quiet hour = 1:002:30pm local hub time (no meetings encouraged). It's a trial to reduce midday cognitive load. Teams can opt out if critical customer work. Put a "quiet-hour" tag on your calendar if you want to participate.

maria: Heat advisory question  will there be extra AC or water stations?

facilities: Well run two pop-up cooling stations (ground level & 5th floor) with bottled water and electrolyte packets between 11:30am2:30pm. Portable fans and extra AC will be deployed in common areas. If your floor needs a HEPA / cooling unit, DM facilities with badge # and approximate headcount.

olivia: Commuter shuttle impact? Any schedule changes for the week?

ops-bot: shuttle-update: Peak shuttle times unchanged, but we'll add one late-evening run at 7:30pm Thu for Wellness social. Calendar updated.

kay: Are the meal vouchers contactless? How do we claim?

samir: Vouchers will be a code emailed to your Redwood address each morning of the onsite day. For partners, show the code; cafe will scan QR. If you miss a voucher day, no retro claims.

maria: ADA / sensory considerations? Nap pods noisy for some folks. Any alternatives?

facilities: We reserved Conference Room B as a low-sensory quiet room (soft lighting, no fragrances). Book via calendar if nap pods aren't suitable. We'll provide noise-reducing headphones on request. DM facilities.

olivia: What about childcare or caregiver support during this week?

samir: People Ops: a small caregiver stipend is available for Wellness Week: up to $80/day, max 2 days. Submit receipts to Expensify with tag "wellness-week-2026". Manager approval not required for the stipend, but ask if you need coverage beyond the cap.

kay: Any programming? Yoga / mindfulness?

people-ops: Schedule: lunchtime yoga Tue & Thu (12:15pm) and a 30-min guided meditation Wed 1pm. RSVP links in the Wellness Week calendar. In-person sessions limited to 20 so please RSVP early.

olivia: If Im remote but want a meal voucher, can I get a stipend?

samir: Remote folks: we have a $10 remote meal kit option if you register on the form by Friday. We'll send a one-time remote code.

maria: Are receipts private? Curious because of sensitive caregiver info.

samir: Yes  receipts submitted to Expensify are only visible to People Ops and Finance. Tag "wellness-week-2026".

facilities: Quick safety note: nap pods are monitored by facilities during staffed hours only. If you use them after-hours, do not use fluids or open containers in pods.

samir: TL;DR: sign up if you plan to be onsite (link), book nap pods/quiet room, expect meal codes each morning, use cooling stations, RSVP for activities. Form: https://tiny.redwood/wellness-week. Ping People Ops or Facilities with exceptions. Thanks!
